description: Screenshots and recordings by default (ADR 01177), through the real CLI. Each test runs one case of auto-capture.cjs, which runs doc-detective in .tmp/fac/<case>/ with no auto-capture keys unless the case sets them, then checks the results file and the run folder. The browser cases browse the 8092 test server.

tests.description: Headless Chrome with no keys: every UI step has an automatic screenshot, and the first authored image is 01-…. The context's autoRecording passed with its MP4 under runDir, the report has no ~autorecord step or marker, and summary.steps counts only the authored steps.
Headless Firefox with no keys: every UI step has an automatic screenshot. It's recorded, headed, only where the host can capture the screen; otherwise it stays headless with no recording.
Both HTML copies, the run folder's and the html reporter's in outputDir, resolve every automatic screenshot and the context's MP4.
autoRecord true where the start fails: the context is FAIL, its autoRecording is FAIL with the reason, and the authored steps are SKIPPED.

autoRecord true on headless Firefox where the preflight can't capture: the context passes, and its autoRecording is SKIPPED with the fix text. It hides DISPLAY and Xvfb from the nested run, so it runs on Linux and is SKIPPED elsewhere.
Spec-level autoScreenshot and autoRecord false: no screenshots and no recording.
A test-level autoScreenshot false beats the spec's true.
-r junit leaves out runFolder, but the run folder still holds testResults.json.
-r junit with both keys false writes no run folder.
